insight.headline: OrderCreate Mutation
insight.what_changed: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment. A trackingNumbers field has been added to OrderCreateFulfillmentInput, allowing multiple tracking numbers to be attached to a fulfillment when importing orders. This change enables more accurate tracking and fulfillment management.
insight.developer_impact: Developers using the orderCreate mutation to import orders should update their code to utilize the new trackingNumbers field. This change provides more flexibility in managing fulfillments and tracking numbers. When importing orders, ensure that the trackingNumbers field is properly populated to take advantage of this new feature. Additionally, review existing fulfillment workflows to determine if multiple tracking numbers are required and update the code accordingly.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will benefit from more accurate and detailed tracking information for their orders, improving the overall customer experience and reducing potential issues with order fulfillment.
insight.why_it_matters: This change matters because it provides more flexibility and accuracy in managing orders and fulfillments, which is critical for merchants to ensure timely and efficient delivery of products to customers.

updates.title: @shopify/cli-hydrogen@13.0.4
updates.summary: Hydrogen CLI now supports a new flag --javascript-origin to override the default --dev-origin for customer account push. Local Hydrogen CLI discovery has also been fixed.

updates.title: @shopify/mini-oxygen@4.2.2
updates.summary: MiniOxygen now supports HTTP/2 requests in its Vite request conversion.

updates.title: @shopify/hydrogen@2026.4.5
updates.summary: Hydrogen now recovers customer account login when switching browser contexts or opening multiple login tabs, and uses cryptographically secure randomness for OAuth state values.

updates.title: skeleton@2026.4.6
updates.summary: Newly scaffolded storefronts now recommend the Shopify AI Toolkit.

updates.title: @shopify/create-hydrogen@5.0.39

themes.title: Hydrogen Updates
themes.detail: Multiple Hydrogen-related packages received updates, including @shopify/cli-hydrogen, @shopify/mini-oxygen, @shopify/hydrogen, and @shopify/create-hydrogen, with improvements such as HTTP/2 support, secure OAuth state values, and recommendations for the Shopify AI Toolkit. The skeleton package was also updated to version 2026.4.6.

themes.title: ShopifyQL Expansion
themes.detail: Shop Campaigns performance data is now available via ShopifyQL, allowing analytics and reporting apps to query performance data on behalf of authorized merchants using the existing ShopifyQL schema.
